bug_summary: timeofday() が std::SystemTime::now() を無条件使用しており、wasm64ターゲットではpanicする
pr_title: Simplify timeofday to a single clock path
pr_description: timeofday() carried a separate wasm-target branch reading from wasm_libc_shim, alongside the std SystemTime::now() path used everywhere else. This collapses it to the single std-based implementation, since we don't currently build for that target.
